application.route: CI: Verify the pinned Summa-UI release (windows-latest)

component: Consumption contract: vendored bundle verification on Windows checkouts (docs/SUMMA_INTEGRATION.md, scripts/verify-vendored.mjs)
explanation: Found while setting up GitManager's CI (not reported by the owner). The vendored bundle verified on Linux but failed on windows-latest: Git for Windows checks out with core.autocrlf=true, converts every text file in the vendored guidance to CRLF, and verify-vendored.mjs reports them as modified because the manifest hashes LF bytes. Any consumer with Windows contributors or Windows CI hits this. SUMMA_INTEGRATION.md does not mention line endings. GitManager fixed it with a .gitattributes file (* text=auto eol=lf, third_party/** -text). The capture is a rendering of the CI log lines (the original is in the GitManager Actions run for commit 57b559b).

classification.rationale: The integration contract and its tooling assume byte-identical checkouts but do not say how to guarantee them on Windows. Generalizes to every consumer that vendors the bundle on Windows. Suggested change: document the required .gitattributes in SUMMA_INTEGRATION.md, have vendor-guidance.mjs write a .gitattributes next to the vendored copy, or let verify-vendored.mjs report line-ending-only differences explicitly.
